meta.name: The Spy Who Loved Me
meta.description: Russian and British submarines with nuclear missiles on board both vanish from sight without a trace. England and Russia both blame each other as James Bond tries to solve the riddle of the disappearing ships. But the KGB also has an agent on the case.
meta.slogan: It's the BIGGEST. It's the BEST. It's BOND. And B-E-Y-O-N-D.
